mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block ( member_id, blocked_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{blockedId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.unique_id AS uniqueId, m.name, m.profile_image AS profileImage FROM block b JOIN member m ON b.blocked_id = m.id WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
